COLLECT, CRAFT, and BATTLE your way to the top in this wrestling move collectible card game that lets you innovate like never before. Enter the ring a rookie…leave as the GOAT!

  • Card stat tracking system

  • Player vs Player (Online)

  • Fully 3D card game with animated wrestling moves
  • Custom card creation system
  • Custom card sharing
  • Match creation mode using cards
  • In-game achievement system
  • Card upgrade system
